purpose: Present the content of a thought or opinion.
keywords: I think it will be sunny tomorrow.
I think this is a good method.
I do not think he will come.
restrictions: Direct present 思う normally reports the speaker’s thought; others’ ongoing thoughts often use 思っている.
mistake: Use plain rather than polite form inside the ordinary quoted clause.

segments.role: Present the content of a thought or opinion. Plain clause + と思う.

examples.translation: I think it will be sunny tomorrow.
